raw_text: Next.js TypeScript App Router: `src`; UI `src/components`; hooks `src/hooks`; utilities `src/lib`; routes `src/app`; API `src/app/api/*`; assets `public/`; scripts `scripts/`; Vite `vite-base-template/`. `npm run dev`; `npm run build`; `npm run start`; `npm run lint`; `cd vite-base-template && npm run dev`; `npm --prefix vite-base-template run build`. Strict, `noEmit: true`; `@/*`→`src/*`; ESLint `eslint.config.mjs`; `<REDACTED_USER>/no-explicit-any` disabled; 2 spaces; PascalCase/camelCase/kebab-case; Tailwind v4. No test runner is currently configured. Prefer: Unit/UI: Vitest or Jest + React Testing Library. Place tests next to source: `Component.test.tsx` or under `__tests__/`. Aim for critical-path coverage (core components, API handlers). Commits imperative, concise, scoped. PRs must include: Summary of changes and rationale; Steps to test locally; attach screenshots for UI changes; Linked issue(s) and checklist: builds, lints, and runs locally. `.env.local`; do not commit secrets. `NEXT_PUBLIC_*` client-exposed. Rotate any leaked credentials promptly; prefer per-env keys. Rewrites `/iframe/*` to `src/app/api/iframe`.
